title: **Former Prime Minister of the Israeli regime Ehud Barak:**
text:
**Former Prime Minister of the Israeli regime Ehud Barak:**"

"🔸 Netanyahu is a desperate animal trapped in a threatening situation, and he will do anything to stay in that position of power and not be removed from office."

"🔸 I raised the possibility that Netanyahu might even resort to war on the eve of elections in order to make the formation of a new government impossible and to remain in power until the next elections."

"🔸 This has nothing to do with Israel’s national interests or even with confronting Iran’s nuclear program. There is no information indicating that an immediate attack on Iran is necessary.
